transitions.source_basis: v0.2 methodology plus current design discussion
transitions.pre_state: Discovery is organized around problem statements and possible tools.
transitions.trigger: Start of a new research/opportunity cycle.
transitions.target_state: Discovery is organized around explicit state transitions and only then searches mechanisms.
transitions.desired_delta: Problem becomes a derived description; target transition becomes primary research object.
transitions.oracle: Representation replay must preserve source status and expose an explicit target transition without upgrading evidence.

transitions.pre_state: Offline branches update shared state and an operator must inspect incumbent conflict information.
transitions.trigger: A multi-branch offline synchronization conflict occurs.
transitions.target_state: Operator can identify causal branch/version structure, conflicting properties, current authoritative state, resolution action, and supporting evidence.
transitions.desired_delta: Conflict handling moves from manual reconstruction to evidence-complete resolution.
transitions.kill_test: F1: kill if >=4/5 are fully resolvable without manual reconstruction; survive only if >=2/5 require manual reconstruction due to structural evidence gap.

transitions.pre_state: Recipient receives a recurring CSV/XLSX artifact before a downstream import/action.
transitions.trigger: A new file version is received.
transitions.target_state: Recipient can determine whether the change is cosmetic, structurally relevant, or decision-changing and can accept, reject, or request correction.
transitions.desired_delta: Downstream decision is made earlier and with explicit semantic impact evidence.
strongest_incumbent_set: schema/lineage tools where setup is feasible
transitions.kill_test: F2: kill if incumbent workflow produces the same decision on >=8/10 cases without material configuration burden.

transitions.legacy_record_id: GitHub review routing without premature notification
transitions.pre_state: Review-worthy change reaches repository workflow.
transitions.target_state: Required review is routed conditionally without premature notification.
transitions.desired_delta: Correct reviewer-routing action occurs only when conditions are met.
transitions.kill_scope: Generic problem killed because GitHub + Mergify were judged sufficient for the audited scope.

transitions.pre_state: Multiple operational exports represent related records.
transitions.trigger: Exports are received and need reconciliation.
transitions.target_state: Discrepancies are identified and reconciled into an actionable result.
transitions.desired_delta: Manual cross-file reconciliation is replaced by a practical discrepancy decision.
transitions.kill_scope: Generic file-first reconciliation products already cover CSV/Excel/JSON discrepancy workflows.

transitions.pre_state: Two file versions exist.
transitions.trigger: Recipient needs to know what changed.
transitions.target_state: Structural and row/cell changes are exposed before downstream use.
transitions.desired_delta: Manual comparison is replaced by explicit change detection.
transitions.kill_scope: Current browser/CLI tools cover structure and row/cell comparison.

transitions.pre_state: Import-bound file may contain structural/value problems.
transitions.target_state: Risky/invalid input is detected or repaired before import.
transitions.desired_delta: Import failure or bad data is prevented before downstream action.
transitions.kill_scope: Existing local/browser tools already provide validation, repair and import-risk reporting.

transitions.pre_state: Untrusted execution request exists.
transitions.target_state: Execution occurs inside an isolated bounded runtime.
transitions.desired_delta: Untrusted actions are prevented from escaping declared execution boundaries.
transitions.kill_scope: OpenShell/OpenSandbox already cover the generic isolation/runtime lifecycle scope audited.

transitions.pre_state: Capability/action request is presented.
transitions.target_state: Decision is explicitly allow/deny with relation and policy semantics.
transitions.desired_delta: Unauthorized execution is blocked before effect.
transitions.kill_scope: OPA/OpenFGA/Cedar/SPIRE cover the major generic primitives in the audited scope.

transitions.pre_state: Browser task is expressed as an intent.
transitions.target_state: Deterministic browser actions execute against the required page state.
transitions.desired_delta: Manual browser interaction is replaced by reproducible automation.
transitions.kill_scope: Playwright MCP already provides the generic browser capability surface.

transitions.pre_state: Agent action occurs with runtime evidence.
transitions.target_state: The effect is independently reconstructable and verifiable.
transitions.desired_delta: Acting-agent narrative is no longer the sole basis for effect claims.
transitions.kill_scope: NOA Receipt, AERF, CAVA, AgentProvenance and related prior art substantially overlap the generic target.

transitions.pre_state: Client needs a compatible MCP capability.
transitions.target_state: Server metadata/schema/conformance is discoverable and inspectable.
transitions.desired_delta: Manual server discovery and schema checking are reduced.
transitions.kill_scope: Official MCP Registry + Inspector cover the generic audited scope.

transitions.pre_state: Field operator has no stable connectivity.
transitions.target_state: Data is captured durably offline and synchronized later.
transitions.desired_delta: Connectivity no longer blocks routine collection.
transitions.kill_scope: ODK already provides mature offline collection/synchronization.

transitions.pre_state: Inventory/exports represent current stock.
transitions.target_state: Reorder candidates are identified and ordered using available data.
transitions.desired_delta: Manual reorder calculation is reduced.
transitions.kill_scope: Current spreadsheet templates, CSV-first products and reorder tools cover the generic workflow.

transitions.pre_state: Customer order arrives through DM/WhatsApp/phone.
transitions.target_state: Order is captured, validated and tracked through fulfillment.
transitions.desired_delta: Manual order capture/tracking is replaced by a structured workflow.
transitions.kill_scope: Multiple Algeria-focused products already cover broad DM/WhatsApp/COD capture and tracking.

transitions.pre_state: Research, execution and evidence are distributed across projects and experiments.
transitions.trigger: A research/action event needs durable provenance and decision linkage.
transitions.target_state: The event is represented through a common control/evidence lineage surface.
transitions.desired_delta: Project-local facts can be linked to claims, evidence, decisions and verification without making the repository itself the architecture.

transitions.pre_state: A capability request could otherwise rely on stale authorization, broad approval scope, or an unbounded cached replay.
transitions.trigger: Capability execution or idempotent replay is attempted.
transitions.target_state: Current policy/relation is revalidated; approval is request-scoped; execution records authorization at execution time; receipt preserves historical authority; revoked replay is denied.
transitions.desired_delta: Execution crosses the authority boundary only under current authorization and retains reconstructable historical authorization.
transitions.oracle: Existing proof lab + unit tests + receipt validation.
negative_findings_preserved: Earlier replay path could use cached observation after revoke.
Earlier receipts recomputed current authority instead of execution-time authority.

transitions.pre_state: Mutation mechanism may change more state than declared or leave partial state after failure.
transitions.target_state: Actual delta remains within declared scope/budget/postconditions, with rollback on violation or partial executor failure and a receipt containing pre/post state and delta.
transitions.desired_delta: Mutation becomes bounded, reversible on violation, and independently reconstructable.

transitions.pre_state: A run may lose identity/state across retry or process restart.
transitions.target_state: Run identity and effect semantics survive restart; same run can be retried without duplicate execution.
transitions.desired_delta: Transition identity remains stable across process failure.

transitions.pre_state: Caller cannot determine whether an external side effect occurred after a process/provider failure.
transitions.target_state: UNKNOWN is reconciled to COMPLETED or CONFIRMED_NOT_EXECUTED, or remains explicitly unresolved without unsafe automatic duplication.
transitions.desired_delta: External effect uncertainty becomes an explicit convergent state machine.

transitions.pre_state: A research operation produces a candidate state/claim with uncertain provenance.
transitions.target_state: Observed result is separated from interpretation and promoted only through explicit verification/evidence.
transitions.desired_delta: Research state transitions remain provenance-bound and non-inflationary.

transitions.pre_state: Creator/experience material exists in draft/feed workflow.
transitions.trigger: Experience becomes publishable under host/runtime constraints.
transitions.target_state: A usable feed experience is published and consumed with the intended interaction semantics.
transitions.desired_delta: Creation-to-consumption workflow produces repeatable user-visible feed behavior.

transitions.pre_state: Local business information/order/content is fragmented across manual channels.
transitions.trigger: Business publishes or updates operational/customer-facing information.
transitions.target_state: Information is represented in a structured localized workflow suitable for the intended business action.
transitions.desired_delta: Manual fragmentation is reduced without requiring a generic all-in-one ERP replacement.

transitions.pre_state: Residual demand exceeds tolerance on one or more dimensions.
transitions.trigger: Mechanisms contribute rates K_im over horizon T.
transitions.target_state: Residual_i <= epsilon_i for all required dimensions.
transitions.desired_delta: Choose a mechanism set that closes the required rate gap within constraints/cost.
transitions.formula: residual_i(x) = D_i * exp(-(k_i + sum_m K_im x_m) * T)
relations_under_review: R2 k identification under Gaussian log-noise
R5 exponential feasibility equals linear rate covering
transitions.important_limit: No new execution result is claimed in this representation because data-analysis execution was unavailable in this turn.

next_discriminating_action: Run deterministic representation replay from source_snapshot + bt-v0.3-reencode-v0.1 mapping; then execute incumbent-only F1/F2 without candidate tooling and record results as separate experiments.
